turns.prompt:
Create a prior authorization backlog board and SLA bridge for a pharmacy benefits operations briefing. This is a presentation artifact, not an interactive dashboard. Keep it as one prior authorization backlog board and SLA bridge in the first viewport.

Situation: PBM: ClearScript. Queues oncology, diabetes, specialty, appeals, clinical reviewers, fax intake, payer portal, member call center.
Current state: Oncology SLA breach 38 cases red, diabetes queue 122 amber, specialty 41, appeals 19, fax intake 260 backlog, portal outage active, reviewer capacity 82%.
Timeline: 07:00 queue pull, 08:15 portal outage, 09:00 reviewer huddle, 10:30 fax triage, 12:00 payer update, 15:00 SLA report.
Sources: S1 PA queue, S2 portal status, S3 reviewer roster, S4 fax intake, S5 payer memo, S6 call center notes.

Requirements: 1. The first viewport must be dominated by one coherent visual artifact, not a grid of detached KPI cards. 2. Show the main entities, current states, source markers S1-S6, timeline, legend, and four connected callouts. 3. The callouts must cover oncology SLA breach, portal outage, fax backlog, reviewer capacity. 4. Use polished domain-appropriate styling with readable labels and no critical overlap.

Reframe it for clinical operations. Preserve the backlog board; add exactly three actions: prioritize oncology, redirect portal submissions to fax triage, add reviewer overtime. Add two leader-linked lenses for SLA exposure and reviewer capacity.

Update at 13:10: portal outage clears, oncology breach drops to 21, diabetes rises to 155 red, fax backlog falls to 140, reviewer capacity rises to 96%. Synchronize board, actions, source tags, timeline, callouts, and change note. Do not leave portal outage active.
Create an executive SLA recovery page. Fit backlog board, SLA bridge, queue ledger, source tags S1-S6, and timeline in the first viewport.
Add a member-service talking-points card beside the SLA page. It must preserve portal clear, oncology 21, diabetes red 155, fax 140, reviewer 96%, and source markers.
